# This layer calibrates context-free top-1 conversion for common readings.
# It replaces an existing lattice edge; it does not add a second copy of that
# edge. Issue #62 introduces missing IT/business compounds the generated
# glossary never emitted, then re-prices compounds that already existed but
# lost to a cheaper homophone split (昨日, 研修, 決済, 移動, 規定, 配布, 生産,
# 商標). It does not retune 昨日 itself, and it does not take date compounds
# such as 昨日以外 away from 昨日.
# Single-digit rows: upstream prices every Arabic digit in one numeral class
# (left/right id 2044, BOS cost 2508) far below the words that share its
# reading, so a bare digit won the top-1 for most number readings -- typing
# はち offered 8 ahead of 鉢, 蜂 and 八. A digit is a spelling of the numeral,
# not a word of its own, so each digit edge is priced 60 above the same
# reading's kanji numeral (八 for はち), or above its last ordinary spelling
# where the trimmed lexicon carries no kanji numeral (よん, ぜろ). The digit
# then follows its numeral on the first candidate page instead of leading it.
# Costs are lattice totals minus the shared 2508 BOS cost; prediction cost
# keeps upstream's +1200 offset. Every row keeps an empty annotation:
# this column is the candidate note the user sees. Developer reasons stay
# in these `#` comments. A `[calibration]` or `[company]` tag here ships
# as a visible candidate tag.
# Cadence vocabulary: the pinned Mozc source carries 月次 and 日次, but no
# 週次 entry at all (only the personal name 周次). Keep the missing member of
# that productive series in the curated layer rather than raising the global
# trim ceiling and admitting every high-cost tail entry.
# Homophone top-1 re-pricing (Issue #94): where a reading's two spellings sit
# within a few hundred cost of each other, the rarer word led the list.
# たいあん offered 大安, a lucky-day label from the traditional calendar,
# ahead of 対案; きんそく offered 禁足 (confinement) ahead of 禁則, the
# line-breaking rule every editor and typesetter uses; たいせき offered the
# geological 堆積 ahead of 体積. Each row re-prices only the more common
# spelling so its lattice total lands 60 below the incumbent -- the same
# margin the digit rows use -- which flips the top-1 and leaves the rest of
# the page in its existing order. Each row keeps the upstream edge's own
# prediction cost and flags, so a row that was not a prediction entry
# (たいあん, きんそく) does not become one.
# The frequency verdict is a linguistic judgment, not a corpus measurement:
# no external frequency corpus is consulted here, exactly as for the rows
# above. がいちゅう (外注 over 害虫) and しれい (指令 over 司令) are the
# closest calls and are recorded as such; the other six are clear.
# しれい (指令) and たいせき (体積) are re-priced the same way, but in
# `curated-general-details.tsv` instead of here: a reviewed description
# already owns those exact edges, and dictc requires a reviewed detail
# source and the final entry to agree on cost and flags. Pricing them here
# would replace the edge that file describes and break that check, so the
# edge keeps one owner and the numbers live next to the description.
# くせ (癖) and ふさい (負債) follow the same homophone rule for Issue #282.
# Upstream prices 曲 (4216) below 癖 (4832) and 夫妻 (5022) below 負債
# (5128), each pair in one noun class, and the glossary's discounted 癖 and
# 負債 edges used to hide that. Once glossary edges yield rank one to the
# word that owns the reading, 曲 led くせ and 夫妻 led ふさい and, because a
# word cost holds in every context, so did every phrase built from them
# (くせがある offered 曲がある, ふさいがある 夫妻がある). Each row replaces the
# glossary edge, so it keeps that edge's `it` flag: its lattice total after
# the shipped 10% IT reduction lands 60 below the Mozc incumbent, and a
# higher recent-IT bias only widens the lead. The name-suffix 夫妻 edge
# (class 2040) that builds 山田夫妻 is a different edge and keeps its price.
# Issues #60/#108: preserve ordinary lexical units instead of memorizing
# complete logged sentences. Restore upstream 漢字 pricing so the ordinary
# noun 感じ is not displaced after adjectival modifiers. Supply the missing
# maintainer / response-measure words and calibrate existing lexical edges
# that lost to a shorter homophone splice. Keep POS identities and alternate
# spellings; the ね/値 correction affects only that suffix reading, not ち/値.
reading
# Issue #337: Mozc prices the plain-kana spelling of these words below the
# kanji spelling the user means, so conversion led with the unconverted
# reading. Same rule as the homophone rows below: the kanji edge lands 60
# under the kana edge it has to lead; the kana spelling stays the next
# candidate. Rows priced <= 6000 follow the overlay's prediction contract:
# predict flag and word cost + 1200.
# - よろしくおねがいします: Mozc carries only the kana phrase (5256, ids 12/240);
#   the split よろしく + お願いします totals 9134 against 7716. 5196 = 5256 - 60.
# - たしかに: Mozc carries the adverb only in kana (3359, ids 12/12), so
# - おまかせ: the noun おまかせ (4932, ids 1841/1841) joins its neighbours more
#   cheaply than お任せ (1953, prefix + verb ids 2597/701); a noun-class
#   お任せ at 4872 = 4932 - 60 removes the connection gap.
# - あけまして, いか: Mozc has both spellings in one class and the kana one is
#   cheaper by 195 and 107. These rows replace Mozc's kanji edge:
# おい/置い is deliberately not re-priced: the kana おい is also the stem of
# において and ておく, so it needs a context rule (follow-up #353).
あけまして
いか
おまかせ
たしかに
よろしくおねがいします

# Issue #334: a word must not absorb the function word before it.
# 合ってる (825 -> 1097) is 3118 upstream. Once the generated contracted forms
# are priced like the split they replace, 2900 keeps これであってる on
# で + 合ってる instead of これ + 出会ってる. 用 (よう, suffix classes 1978 and
# 2031) costs 3 upstream, so ます + 用 was nearly free in ...ますよう; +600
# keeps the whole word. 意図 (いと) is the glossary's IT edge: its IT bonus let
# これぐらいな + 意図 beat これぐらい + ない + と although the dictionary-only
# path of the latter is 399 cheaper. The row keeps the glossary price and
# drops the IT flag, prediction cost included (word cost + 300), so the term
# stays on its prediction page; the English term `intent` keeps its own IT
# row. The other rows follow this file's prediction contract (word cost + 1200).

# Issue #336: noun homophones whose expected word lost on a price, on the
# per-reading edge limit, or because no compound edge existed. Each row
# replaces or adds exactly one edge and keeps the contract above (rows at or
# below 6,000 are predictive with word cost + 1,200; dearer rows are not).
# Costs come from the lattice totals of the sentences that failed and were
# checked against the standalone leaders pinned in the ranking tests.
# あん/案 and かた/型: the 案 and 型 edges (1851) sat 14th and 17th among the
# edges of their reading, behind the per-reading edge limit, so the lattice
# never saw them. 案 is priced at 4780, 65 below the 4845 edge, which lifts it
# to 12th; 型 at 3000 admits it and keeps 方 first for a bare かた. 型 carries
# no `it` flag: with the flag a bare かた would convert to 型 and a general
# sentence such as 左の方が痛い would break.
# しょうたい/招待: at 4247, 招待 stood 73 behind 正体 after the connection
# costs of カレンダーの招待 were added; 4110 turns that around. This edge has
# a reviewed description, so curated-homophone-details.tsv carries the same
# price and dictc fails the build if the two disagree.
# さいしゅうばん/最終版 and ふどうしょうすうてん/浮動小数点 add missing compound
# edges; without them 最終盤 and 不動小数点 beat the split spellings.
# 機能フラグ, 検索機能, 印紙税 and 一時停止 are whole-compound edges whose lead
# must not depend on the IT compound coherence bonus of a multi-word path, so
# that bonus can be narrowed later (Issue #352) without moving them. 検索機能
# replaces the generated edge and adds the `it` flag. 戻り値 needs no row: its
# alias 返り値 is priced behind it by the glossary generator (Issue #332).

# Issue #371: everyday phrases the developer history kept converting wrong,
# measured on the 2.0.18 dictionary with learning and the reranker off.
# Each row lands 60 below the path that led (the #94 margin), measured as a
# lattice total, so the old leader stays the second candidate.
# のないように: the particle の that continues to 内容 connects 1,600 cheaper
# than the one before ない, so 失礼のないように and 誤解のないように split
# into の内容に. Whole-phrase edges (left id of the noun, right id of the
# final に, as Mozc's own trimmed 失礼のないように row at 7838) fix only these
# set phrases; a general のないように edge would also take メールの内容に誤りが.
# 精度/制度 and 形勢/形成: 制度 and 形成 rightly lead the bare readings and
# every other context (制度を変える, 形成する). The compound edges cover the
# collocations where only 精度 or 形勢 makes sense: 精度 + が/も/の + 高い/低い
# (the adjective's terminal form, right id 2425) and 形勢が逆転. Other
# inflections (精度が高く) and particles still convert as before.
# 成金: Mozc prices 成金 at 8200, above the 6900 trim ceiling, so only 成り金
# (6279) reached the dictionary; the row admits 成金 at 6219.
# まるまる: the kana adverb edge (16/16, 4038) sat 45 below 丸々 (4083) and
# the placeholder 〇〇 (1851, 4532) led both through a cheaper connection.
# 丸々 is re-priced 60 below the kana edge, and 〇〇 moves 5 behind the kana
# spelling, third on the page; 〇〇さん still leads its own reading.
# Not here: にかい -> に書い and にしゅうかん -> に習慣 win because a path ending
# in a 連用タ接続 form or a bare particle split pays no end-of-input penalty;
# that is a lattice rule, not a price (Issue #341 owns the numeral readings).
